    dur = 0.6
    t = np.linspace(0, dur, int(sr*dur), endpoint=False)

    wave = noise * env * 0.7
    wave = (wave * 32767).astype(np.int16)
    return wave

    t = np.linspace(0, dur, int(sr*dur), endpoint=False)
    noise = np.random.randn(len(t))
    env = np.exp(-t*4)
    wave = noise * env * 0.5
    wave = (wave * 32767).astype(np.int16)
    return wave

# 5. Bass: sawtooth, loopable

    t = np.linspace(0, dur, int(sr*dur), endpoint=False)

    wave = wave * 0.8
    wave = (wave * 32767).astype(np.int16)

    wave = (wave * 32767).astype(np.int16)

    t = np.linspace(0, dur, int(sr*dur), endpoint=False)

    wave = wave * 0.6
    wave = (wave * 32767).astype(np.int16)
